High Ledge Rescue.name: High Ledge Rescue
High Ledge Rescue.description: The user secures one adult against their back and leaps up to twelve meters across or six meters upward this turn, anchoring their tongue to a firm ledge within twenty meters to steady the landing. This moves a casualty over floodwater or onto a balcony. The anchor must bear both bodies, and the user cannot attempt another loaded leap until their next turn ends. Strain: severe.
